_status: Official B3 calendar, transcribed 2026-11-12. Only years listed under `years` are known; b3/calendar.py refuses to answer for any other year unless dates are inferred from data (Holidays.with_inferred). Never extend this file from memory: add a year only from its B3 Oficio Circular and cite it.

2026.source: B3 Oficio Circular 041/2026-VNC (30/06/2026, errata that replaces OC 003/2026-VNC of 08/01/2026), Anexo 1, Quadro A; same list in the B3 news release of 09/01/2026 (https://www.b3.com.br/pt_br/noticias/calendario-de-negociacao-da-b3-confira-o-funcionamento-da-bolsa-em-2026.htm). The errata only changed the US-holiday table (CSD2), not the Brazilian closures.

closed.2026-11-20: Dia Nacional de Zumbi e Consciencia Negra
closed.2026-12-24: Vespera de Natal (sem sessao de negociacao)
closed.2026-12-31: Expediente interno nas instituicoes bancarias (sem sessao de negociacao)

2026-02-18.note: Quarta-feira de Cinzas: pre-abertura 12h45, negociacao a partir das 13h (B3 news release of 09/01/2026; OC 054/2025-VNC Anexo 2).

sao_paulo_holidays_with_normal_trading.2026-07-09: Revolucao Constitucionalista (B3 funciona normalmente, OC 041/2026-VNC Quadro B)
